name: Moin Bin Umair
title: Director · Cinematographer · Photographer
tagline: Simplicity is complex. Design is a process. Style is everything.
about: Director and cinematographer working across film, commercial, and documentary.
I make work that captures what goes unsaid — a feeling that never found words, a moment that passed before anyone noticed.
From narrative shorts to brand campaigns, every frame is a deliberate choice in light, movement, and story.
